residual_risks: The four GBU terminal-stub IPC-2221 screen failures remain and correctly keep the power-entry unit overall status failed.
The IPC-2221 scalar is a uniform-trace screen; it does not qualify pad/barrel current sharing, finite-length heat spreading, terminal temperature, transients, or powered hardware.

The retained manufacturing receipt names an isolated Luna checkout path, but its board hash matches the canonical board and the canonical all-unit report independently binds the current board/evidence bytes.
testing_gaps: No new regression test was added for the single native width edit; existing mutation and saved-board checks were exercised.
